name: coinnavigator
description: CoinNavigator static site + net profit calculation engine

scripts.build:engine: tsup --config tsup.config.ts && node -e "const fs=require('fs'); const a='assets/js/net-profit-engine.global.js'; const b='assets/js/net-profit-engine.js'; if (fs.existsSync(a)) { fs.renameSync(a,b); }"
scripts.build: npm run typecheck && npm run build:engine && npm run build:alerts && npm run build:route-validator && npm run build:market-data
scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm run test && npm run build:engine && npm run build:alerts && npm run build:route-validator && npm run build:market-data && node --check assets/js/net-profit-engine.js && node --check api/alerts/index.js && node --check api/alerts/unsubscribe.js && node --check api/route-validator/index.js && node --check api/market-data/index.js && node --check assets/js/profit-calculator-ui.js && node --check assets/js/spread-engine.js && node --check assets/js/dashboard-table.js
